# Precision Equipments Chennai Pvt. Ltd. (PECPL)
Precision Equipments Chennai Pvt. Ltd. (PECPL) is an engineering and manufacturing company specializing in heat exchangers and critical process equipment. Established in 1981, PECPL serves industries including oil & gas, petrochemicals, fertilizers, LNG, power, chemical processing, FPSO, FSRU, renewable energy, and data-centre cooling.

## Global Presence
PECPL has established an international presence through **10+ representations worldwide**, enabling the company to support customers across different geographical markets and industrial sectors.

## Scale and Experience
With a workforce of **500+ employees**, more than **1000 clients**, **10+ worldwide representations**, and **5500+ equipment supplied**, PECPL has extensive experience in delivering engineered equipment for critical industrial applications.

## Products
- [Shell and Tube Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/): Heat exchanger solutions for demanding industrial heat transfer applications.
- [Conventional Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/conventional-heat-exchangers/): Conventional shell and tube heat exchanger solutions for industrial processes.
- [Helixchanger®](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/helixchanger/): Helical-baffle heat exchanger technology designed to improve heat transfer efficiency and reduce pressure drop and vibration.
- [Rod Baffle Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/rod-baffle-heat-exchangers/): Rod baffle heat exchangers designed for high-fouling applications and improved heat transfer performance.
- [Cryogenic Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/cryogenic-heat-exchangers/): Heat exchanger solutions for cryogenic and low-temperature industrial applications.
- [High Pressure Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/high-pressure-heat-exchangers/): High-pressure heat transfer equipment for demanding process conditions.
- [Low Fin Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/low-fin-heat-exchangers/): Low-fin heat exchanger solutions designed for enhanced heat transfer performance.
- [High Flux Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/high-flux-heat-exchangers/): High-flux heat transfer solutions for applications requiring high thermal performance.
- [Condensers](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/condensers/): Industrial condenser solutions for process and energy applications.
- [Feed Water Heaters](https://pecpl.com/products/shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers/feed-water-heaters/): Feed water heating solutions for industrial and power applications.
- [Plate & Shell Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/plate-shell-heat-exchangers/): Compact plate and shell heat exchanger solutions.
- [Plate & Frame Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/plate-frame-heat-exchangers/): Plate and frame heat exchanger solutions for industrial heat transfer requirements.
- [Air Fin Cooler & Air Cooled Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/air-fin-cooler-air-cooled-heat-exchangers/): Air-cooled heat transfer equipment for industrial applications.
- [Hairpin Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/hairpin-heat-exchangers/): Hairpin heat exchanger solutions for high-temperature and high-pressure applications.
- [Double Pipe Heat Exchangers](https://pecpl.com/products/double-pipe-heat-exchangers/): Double pipe heat exchanger solutions for industrial process applications.
- [Pressure Vessels](https://pecpl.com/products/pressure-vessels/): Pressure vessel manufacturing for critical industrial processes.
- [Columns & Reactors](https://pecpl.com/products/columns-reactors/): Process columns and reactors designed for industrial processing applications.
- [Process Skid](https://pecpl.com/products/process-skid/): Engineered process skid solutions for integrated industrial process requirements.
